T1.title: Migrate seed.py to SuperTokens
T1.description: Refactor api/seed.py so that it creates the admin and demo users in SuperTokens using the emailpassword recipe instead of Supabase Auth. After creating the SuperTokens user, it should also upsert their profile into the Supabase profiles table to maintain relational integrity.
acceptance_criteria: admin@meenamma.in and demo@meenamma.in can be authenticated locally
